description: Delete a media folder. By default only empty folders are removed; pass deleteContents to also delete the assets inside, and force to override the refusal that protects assets still in use.

_confirm.description: Confirmation ref this server issued for this exact call after the user approved it. Never invent or reuse one.

deleteContents.description: When true, also delete the assets inside the folder. When false (default), deletion is refused if the folder is not empty.

force.description: When true, delete assets that pages, records or branding still reference. The refusal names those files. Requires the media:force-delete permission.

name: delete_media_folder
title: Delete media folder
